  • Class
    Description
    BrowseText
    The wording of the Browse Marketplace screen (UC8), kept apart from the JavaFX code so it can be unit-tested.
    ChatList
    The chat screen, the same in the buyer and seller portals (UC6 Chat About Listing; Tasks 1.5 and 2.5): every chat of the logged-in user in a list, the one with the newest message or offer first, and the chosen chat (ChatView) beside the list, as in a desktop messenger, with a light grey line between them.
    ChatText
    The wording of the shared chat screens (ChatView, ChatList), kept apart from the JavaFX code so it can be unit-tested.
    ChatView
    The chat screen, the same in the buyer and seller portals (UC6 Chat About Listing; Tasks 1.5 and 2.5): the history of messages and offers with sender and time, a box to write a message, and a search of the history that jumps to the chosen message and highlights it.
    ChatView.AgreeToCounter
    What the buyer's Agree to Counter does with the countered offer they chose: Make Offer with the counter's terms filled in (UC5 step 1 and Special Requirement 4).
    ChatView.RespondToOffers
    What the seller's Respond in Offers & Requests does: the seller portal shows its Manage Offers & Requests screen with these offers marked (Scrolling.JUMP_HIGHLIGHT) and the newest one scrolled into view (Scrolling.bringIntoView(javafx.scene.control.ScrollPane, javafx.scene.Node)), as a chat search result is (UC6 A2 step 4).
    Choices
    Filter choices of the form "All categories" followed by the values of an enum, as the buyer's Browse Marketplace (UC8 step 3) and Deal History (UC11 step 3) screens use them.
    ContentHost
    Somewhere a screen can be shown: each portal's dashboard, whose main area shows one screen at a time.
    DealText
    The wording of the My Deals screen (UC7), kept apart from the JavaFX code so it can be unit-tested.
    Dialogs
    The dialogs every portal uses, so confirmations, messages and errors look and behave the same everywhere (non-functional requirement: consistent interaction across the three portals).
    Formats
    One way to show dates, prices, ratings and periods on every screen, so all three portals look and read the same (non-functional requirement: a consistent interface).
    HistoryText
    The wording of the Deal History screen (UC11), kept apart from the JavaFX code so it can be unit-tested.
    ListingCard
    The listing card, the same in all three portals (non-functional requirement: shared components for cards).
    ListingOverview
    The top of a listing's detail screen, the same in every portal: all photos, the title with the status badge and the price, every field, and the full description (UC8 step 7; the admin's "full listing details", Manage Marketplace Listings 5.1).
    ListingSummary
    What a listing card shows, worked out once from a listing and the store.
    ListingSummary.Field
    One named value on the listing detail screen, such as "Condition" and "Used".
    LiveUpdates
    Tells the open dashboard that the data changed without the user doing anything, so the screen it shows can reload.
    NotificationBoard
    The notification board, the same in all three portals (UC4 View Notifications; Tasks 1.8, 2.7, 3.6).
    NotificationDot
    The red dot on a portal's Notifications button, with the number of unread notifications, the same in all three portals (assumptions register 92).
    OfferText
    How a price offer, borrow request or claim reads on every screen that shows one: the chat history (UC6), My Deals (UC7), the seller's offers and the admin's deal records.
    PhotoFrame
    A frame of a fixed size that shows one listing photo, the same everywhere a photo appears: the thumbnail on a listing card (Task 1.3), the photos on the listing detail screen (Task 1.4) and in the admin's review (Task 3.2).
    ProfileView
    The profile screen, the same in all three portals (UC3 Manage Profile; Tasks 1.7, 2.6, 3.4).
    Refreshable
    A screen that can reload its data while it is open, for example after the borrowing-deadline timer returned an item (UC12 step 4: the change shows on the open My Deals screen).
    ReportText
    The wording of the buyer's report form (UC9 Report Listing), kept apart from the JavaFX code so it can be unit-tested.
    ReviewList
    A seller's average rating and reviews, each with its stars, date, comment and the seller's reply, if any.
    ReviewText
    How a seller's rating and reviews read on every screen that shows them: the listing detail screen and the seller's profile (UC8 step 7 and A3), and the seller's and admin's own review screens; and the wording of the buyer's review form (UC10).
    Scrolling
    Jumping to one item of a long screen and marking it, shared by every portal so the pattern looks and works the same everywhere: the chat search jumps to the chosen message and highlights it (UC6 A2 step 4); the seller's Offers & Requests shows the offers a chat's Respond in Offers & Requests links to (assumptions register 71). Where to scroll is worked out in Scrolling.position(double, double, double, double), apart from JavaFX, so it is unit-tested.
    SubScreen
    A screen opened from another screen: a Back button above the content, the same in every portal.
    TextInputs
    Checks for text typed into dialogs and forms.
